uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3062-3099-4762-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting three +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Yoshimaru and Pir.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Mana Dork or Mana Dork Creator

129-4222--140.easyPrerequisites:
Freed from the Real is attached to the mana dork.
The mana dork doesn't have summoning sickness.
129-4222--140.description:
Activate the mana dork by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping the mana dork.
Repeat.
129-4222--140.notes: The chosen mana dork must produce {U} or more when tapped. The extra mana can be funneled into Kinnan's activated ability if the creature can also produce {G}.

34-147-413.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-413.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

240-3899-4927-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

275-4668-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
275-4668-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Heliod
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-1849-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-1849-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3532-5078-6556-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

5010-5256-5659-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Golgari Thug's power, which will cause you to mill Golgari Thug.
As Golgari Thug is a Lhurgoyf due to Leyline of Transformation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Golgari Thug from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3000-5670-7452.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-7452.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

813-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Scholar of the Ages and exiling Ephemerate.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2178-6797-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-3000-4659-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

4681-5170-6634-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2893-3875-4136-5478.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5113-5344-6349.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
5113-5344-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2457-4094-4289-6968.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

681-4693-5478-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-4693-5478-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2511-3558-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2292-3234-3293-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2292-3234-3293-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat
2292-3234-3293-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1012-2034-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
1012-2034-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1170-3200-4211-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-3200-4211-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is modified

460-539-5845.description:
Activate Orochi Merge-Keeper by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

104-1818-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1818-4186.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-1563-4321-5777.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an artifact creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

1424-1978-2034.description:
Activate the artifact creature with Presence of Gond attached by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature with Presence of Gond attached.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

955-1270-3228-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

645-1267-4050-5361.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-4050-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

880-2692-5478.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2692-5478.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1289-5078-5741-5864.notablePrerequisites: Birds of Paradise does not have summoning sickness.
1289-5078-5741-5864.description:
Activate Birds of Paradise by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

2177-3096-5962.description:
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, exiling all nonland cards in your library.
Cast Demonlord Belzenlok by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Demonlord Belzenlok enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling the remainder of your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to mill two cards and win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2034-2724-3194-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
2034-2724-3194-5131.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {C}{C}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger when it enters the battlefield due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

3593-3952-5231.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Firestorm Phoenix onto the battlefield from your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Firestorm Phoenix, adding {R}.
Firestorm Phoenix is returned to your hand instead of being put into your graveyard.
Repeat.

1624-2201-4827.description:
During the end step before your turn, activate Evra by paying {4}, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

262-812-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Chained Brute.
Chained Brute does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
262-812-5231.description:
Activate Chained Brute by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing an Elemental, adding {R}.
Activate Chained Brute by paying {1} and sacrificing an Elemental, untapping Chained Brute.
Repeat.

2367-3490-4659-4772.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

1651-1692-2179-5116.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Kurkesh.
1651-1692-2179-5116.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary copy of Kurkesh with haste.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping itself and Helm of the Host, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Both Kurkeshes trigger.
Resolve both Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R}{R} to copy Clock of Omens' ability twice, targeting Clock of Omens and Helm of the Host.
Resolve all Clock of Omens abilties, untapping it, Helm of the Host and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 3.

864-2334-3617.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
